items.summary: Hi HN, I'm Musab and I'm building Manalect. Find TL;DR at the end. Most language apps fall short for me in two ways: 1. They’re not personalized enough. I get taught things I don’t care about, things that are too hard for me, and things I already know. 2. They don’t teach that well. I keep seeing question types where my brain does almost no work to figure out the answer, therefore learn nothing. I think the biggest reason they're not personalized enough is that they don't have a detailed enough representation of a language. Most apps have efficient review scheduling for the words you learn. Show HN: I got tired of travel spreadsheets so I made a travel planner app
items.summary: Hey everyone! I couldn't find an app to organize trips that gave me all the info I wanted to schedule each stop per day, with travel times, leeway, etc, so I made Wherewhen. The basic differentiator is that you can set various constraints (e.g. "I want to spend 2 hours in the park", or "I have a dinner reservation at 6"), and Wherewhen will automatically adjust the rest of the times to tell you when to go/leave each place, including travel. I've tried to make it mobile-friendly but travel planning is pretty complicated and it's a bit clunky on mobile. Feedback is appreciated!
